# Neighbour Signal

## Stage control

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `bool` | `True` | `basic` | Run neighbour-attributable signal analysis when the stage is selected. | Disable only when a planned workflow should retain the stage without executing it. |

## Output asset

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `output_adata_path` | `str` | `neighbour_attributable_signal.h5ad` | `basic` | Separate AnnData output whose X matrix contains neighbour-attributable fractions. | Use a path different from general.anndata_path; the input AnnData is never modified. |
| `calculate_classic_intensities` | `bool` | `True` | `basic` | Store conventional mean raw-marker intensity within each segmentation mask. | Internal raw-image reductions still run when this output layer is disabled. |

## Cell mapping and exemplars

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `exemplar_obs` | `str` | `Exemplar_stains` | `basic` | Categorical AnnData observation whose non-null values name convincing positive marker exemplars. | Values must exactly match marker names on the AnnData variable axis. |
| `object_id_obs` | `str` | `ObjectNumber` | `basic` | AnnData observation containing the positive integer label used in each ROI segmentation mask. | Each (ROI, object ID) pair must be unique and present in the corresponding mask. |

## Halo model

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `max_halo_px` | `int` | `8` | `basic` | Maximum outward distance in pixels learned and projected from each source-cell mask. | Interpret this in the native pixel grid of the configured raw images and masks. |
| `min_exemplars` | `int` | `5` | `basic` | Minimum number of valid exemplar profiles required to model one marker. | Markers below this count are reported and assigned zero neighbour-attributable fractions. |
| `halo_aggregation` | `Literal['max', 'sum']` | `max` | `basic` | Pixel-level rule for overlapping projected source halos. | Use max normally; sum is more aggressive when several source halos overlap. |

## Source definition

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `source_anchor_dilation_px` | `int` | `2` | `basic` | Small outward dilation used to calculate each cell's robust raw-image source strength. | Unassigned pixels are allocated to their nearest cell; pixels assigned to other cells are excluded. |
| `source_anchor_quantile` | `float` | `0.95` | `basic` | Raw-image quantile within the source anchor used as source strength. | High quantiles remain robust to conservative nuclear masks for membrane or cytoplasmic markers. |
| `source_threshold_quantile` | `float` | `0.1` | `basic` | Quantile of valid exemplar source strengths used as the marker-specific source threshold. | The default admits cells in the lower edge of the exemplar-positive brightness regime. |

## Resources

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `n_jobs` | `Union[Literal['auto'], int]` | `auto` | `basic` | ROI-level worker processes, or auto to follow the current SLURM/CPU allocation. | Workers load one mask and marker images lazily; avoid nested multiprocessing. |

## QC report

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `qc_markers` | `Optional[List[str]]` | `null` | `advanced` | Optional ordered markers used in UMAP and expression-comparison QC figures. | Leave unset to select the most affected markers automatically. |
| `max_qc_markers` | `int` | `6` | `basic` | Maximum automatically selected markers shown in detailed QC figures. | Profile and score-summary tables still include every marker. |
| `population_obs` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `basic` | Optional categorical population observation used for population-by-marker QC. | Null falls back to general.population_obs_primary; missing annotations are skipped cleanly. |
| `high_risk_threshold` | `float` | `0.5` | `advanced` | Descriptive score threshold used only for per-cell counts and QC summaries. | This threshold is not a validated biological cutoff and does not alter the score. |
